description: Fix the format of Brazilian business phone numbers the user already has (a company's or a contact's, e.g. from a sheet) for free: puts them as (DD) NNNNN-NNNN, adds the missing ninth digit of a mobile, and marks a number that cannot exist (an unknown area code, too short). kind is mobile or landline. Up to 500 numbers per call. Formatting only: nothing is looked up outside, and no owner, name or other data comes back.
name: clean_phone
title: Limpar telefone
